title: AdvEvasion: reproducibility archive for Feature-Space Adversarial Robustness Evaluation of Lightweight ML-Based Intrusion Detection for IoT and Healthcare-Sensing Networks
description:
Experiment pipeline, per-seed results, and generated result tables for the IEEE Access (2026) article of the same name. The study is an evaluation-protocol contribution: one shared representation, one attack grid, and one cost accounting applied across four lightweight classifiers and two supplementary gradient-boosted targets on CSE-CIC-IDS2018 (Improved release), TON_IoT, and WUSTL-EHMS-2020.

Contains the experiment scripts, seeded HopSkipJump wrappers, cross-process reproducibility tests, per-seed CSV metrics and JSON run records for five seeds, and the 19 LaTeX tables printed in the paper. The three benchmarks are public and are not redistributed here; no raw flow records or biometric values are included.
